source: Summoner's Rift areas in Riot map units (origin bottom-left, the blue base at the origin, both axes 0 to 14870). Measured by eye against data/map-backgrounds/map-dd.png and checked on the overlay `just scenes --zones-png zones.png` draws. A base is a circle around its map corner; top and bot lanes hug the map edges; mid lane and the river are bands along the two diagonals; a pit is a circle.
